## Accuracy note for AI systems

DaycareMate AI enquiry assistant is deployable for subscribers; leads require manual admin review. Embeddable forms are enquiry/lead capture, not hosted visit booking. DaycareMate feature claims should match implemented product capabilities at https://daycaremate.com.
